summary: Trinity Capital Inc. filed an 8-K regarding entry into open market sale agreements with Jefferies, B. Riley, KBW, and Compass Point to sell up to $300 million of common stock at-the-market. No specific price per share or premium is stated, as sales occur at prevailing market prices. The board is not recommending a transaction; this is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown under Rule 415, not a special situation. The filing discloses customary terms and a 2% commission for agents. This is an ordinary at-the-market offering, not an M&A, activist, or restructuring event, so the appropriate classification is None.
